item.title: Self-Hosted CLI Dictionary and Translation Tools: translate-shell vs sdcv vs dictd — Offline Language Lookup for Your Terminal
item.description:
Why Use CLI Dictionary and Translation Tools?

When you’re deep in terminal work, switching to a browser to look up a word or translate a phrase breaks your flow. CLI dictionary and translation tools let you resolve language questions without leaving the keyboard – and unlike browser-based translators, they can work entirely offline when paired with local dictionary servers.

item.title: LibreTranslate vs Argos Translate: Self-Hosted Translation Server Guide 2026
item.description: If you need to translate text programmatically but want to avoid sending your data to Google Translate, DeepL, or any cloud-based service, self-hosted translation engines are the answer. In 2026, two open-source projects dominate this space: LibreTranslate and Argos Translate.
